title.en: Side view of a dark varnished dog house

alt.tr: Yatay kaplamalı koyu vernikli köpek kulübesinin yeşil shingle çatılı yan yüzü
alt.en: The side of a dark varnished dog house with horizontal cladding and a green shingle roof

caption.tr: Yan yüzeyde yatay tahtalar sıkıca dizilmiş, çatı balık pulu desenli. Arkada atölyenin kereste rafı var.
caption.en: The horizontal boards on the side are tightly laid and the roof has a fish-scale pattern. The workshop's timber rack is behind.
